title: Warm Wholesome Norwegian Lamb Wrap
description: A comforting, flavorful wrap featuring tender lamb, sweet preserves, and a hint of citrus. Perfect for a lazy Sunday.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the butter over medium heat.
Add the lamb to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the lamb is tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and preserved rose petal jelly.
Warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Slice the cooked lamb into thin strips.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a tablespoon of the lemon-jelly mixture on each wrap, followed by a few slices of lamb, some chopped parsley, and a sprinkle of red pepper flakes (if using).
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 4 wraps.
